title: RocksDB LSM-tree leveled compaction SSTable key range overlap under concurrent flush
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0510: RocksDB LSM-tree leveled compaction SSTable key range overlap under concurrent flush
Repository: `facebook/rocksdb`
Category: `Storage Engine Crash Consistency & WAL`
Target File: `db/compaction/compaction_picker_level.cc`

#### Problem Description
Flush thread and compaction thread race on level-0 file manifest update, generating duplicate key intervals.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Acquire version_set mutex before editing SSTable level metadata ranges.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0510.py -q`
expected_invariant: Acquire version_set mutex before editing SSTable level metadata ranges.
